approval_source: The sole decision owner explicitly approved the recommended CASE-01 manual workbench, instructed implementation to proceed, and then authorized continuation to resolve remaining in-scope work. This receipt records that approval for the already approved M01-only player-authored manual slice; it does not authorize M04, a global Aka replacement, new save versions, answer revelation, or unrelated protected-path changes.
scope_summary: Implement only the approved CASE-01 Afterlife Station player-authored manual workbench: the Lume guide portrait at its declared runtime path, Canon V2 deduction metadata, draft-only GameState persistence, one native workbench scene, its policy and presentation scripts, and narrow M01 InvestigationScene integration. Preserve existing save-version and filled-slots contracts, non-M01 manual behavior, rescue/recovery semantics, and all unrelated protected paths.
